title: A planner lists the files that name a moved file or symbol
goal: One read-only backlog.py command, given a file or symbol a task will move or delete, lists every tracked file that names it (imports, test_layout.py exceptions, test_kbpublic.py role lists, kb/_self CODE pointers and prose, backlog items), so the task's touches hold them before it starts; it answers SP-rks3vx5g, where TK-pwrigavm, TK-uhu2ankm, TK-mose67gs and TK-2qnfbjsx each had their touches widened mid-flight
